High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Court No. - 80
Case :- Criminal Appeal No. - 6038 of 2023
Appellant :- Ramraj
Respondent :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Appellant :- Mohd. Samiuzzaman Khan

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra,J.
Heard learned counsel for the appellant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the record.

The instant criminal appeal has been preferred against the judgment and order dated 11.04.2023 passed by Sessions Judge, Sant Kabir Nagar in Session Trial No. 32 of 2016 (State Vs. Ramraj)
arising out of Case Crime No. 544 of 2015, under Sections 304B, 498A I.P.C and Section 4 of D.P.
Act, Police Station Mehdawal, District Sant Kabir Nagar whereby the appellant was convicted under Section 304B of I.P.C for maximum sentence of 10 years rigorous imprisonment.
